text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee! I used my gratefully received time off to enjoy a picnic with Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We had a relaxing time out in the sunshine. We caught up, enjoyed a lovely lunch, and even hit the gym together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My time off was rewarding indeed. Thank you very much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now I'm ready to undertake any training regimen you have in mind for me. Just say the word and off we go. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright comes back from her time off refreshed and motivated!
